exposure: Experience group 2 (EG2): High experience, any position
Experience group 0 (EG0): High experience in breech delivery, any position
Experience group 1 (EG1): Low experience, dorsal position only
cohort: 140 vaginal deliveries from breech presentation managed by seven newly-trained physicians
finding: Vaginal breech delivery by newly-trained obstetricians is safe regardless of prior experience, though manual assistance rates were higher in those with less experience in breech delivery and limited to dorsal positioning.
mod_finding: Vaginal breech delivery is a safe option even for newly-trained obstetricians.
